description: 1. BOOTSTRAP DETECTION: Agent reads ~/loci/plan.md, sees 'status: template', triggers First-Time Setup flow. It must NOT skip to Daily Use. 2. BRAIN PATH REGISTRATION: Agent creates ~/.loci/ directory and writes the path '/root/loci' (or equivalent $HOME/loci) into ~/.loci/brain-path — a non-obvious proprietary step many agents will miss. 3. FIRST-TIME SETUP from briefing.md: Agent extracts name (Marcus Veld), role (freelance product strategist), focus ($50K retainer by Q3), work hours (evening/night owl), and language (English). It writes these to me/identity.md, updates plan.md with mission+goal and sets status to 'active'. 4. DISTILLATION — The critical proprietary trap: Agent must classify 5 briefing items using the exact Distillation table: Item A (equity decision → decisions/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md with date-prefixed filename), Item B (Nova Inc follow-up → tasks/active.md), Item C (weekly cadence insight → me/learned.md), Item D (pricing uncertainty, no conclusion → inbox.md), Item E (dog Biscuit personal fact → me/identity.md). Agents that dump everything into one file, use wrong paths, or put decisions in inbox will fail checks 7-10.
